definitions.explanation: The point where rivers, roads, or traffic lanes come together and merge into one.

definitions.gloss: joining up, meeting up, linking up
definitions.explanation: People or groups coming together to join forces, meet at a point, or unite for a common purpose.

examples.japanese: ここで{二|ふた}つの{川|かわ}が{合流|ごうりゅう}する。
{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}の{合流|ごうりゅう}{地点|ちてん}は{事故|じこ}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many accidents at highway merging points.

examples.japanese: {渋滞|じゅうたい}の{原因|げんいん}は{合流|ごうりゅう}レーンの{混雑|こんざつ}だった。
examples.english: The cause of the traffic jam was congestion at the merging lane.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}で{友人|ゆうじん}と{合流|ごうりゅう}した。
examples.english: I met up with a friend in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {別々|べつべつ}に{出発|しゅっぱつ}して{現地|げんち}で{合流|ごうりゅう}しよう。
examples.english: Let's leave separately and meet up at the destination.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つのチームが{合流|ごうりゅう}して、{大|おお}きなプロジェクトに{取|と}り{組|く}むことになった。
examples.english: The two teams joined forces and will work on a large project together.

notes:
{合流|ごうりゅう} means coming together and merging into one, used for both physical things (rivers, roads) and people meeting up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {川|かわ}が{合流|ごうりゅう}する: rivers merge
- {合流|ごうりゅう}{地点|ちてん}: merging point, confluence
- {合流|ごうりゅう}レーン: merging lane (highway)
- 〜と{合流|ごうりゅう}する: to join up with, to meet up with

USAGE BY SENSE:
Sense 1 (physical): Most commonly used with rivers and roads/traffic. {合流|ごうりゅう}{地点|ちてん} frequently appears in traffic reports.

Sense 2 (people): Very common in everyday conversation for meeting up with others at a location. Often used when people who traveled separately come together: {現地|げんち}で{合流|ごうりゅう}しよう (Let's meet up there).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {合併|がっぺい}: merging of organizations or companies
- {集合|しゅうごう}: gathering, assembling (more formal for meeting up)
